target.rawSql: SELECT max(data_celebracao)::timestamp AS time, 'Latest contract date' AS text, 'data-cutoff' AS tags FROM procurement.contracts

list.name: adjudicatario
list.label: Adjudicatário (name or NIPC)
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN entity_id ~ '^[0-9]{9}$' THEN name || ' — ' || entity_id ELSE name END AS __text, entity_id AS __value FROM procurement.entities_adjudicatarios ORDER BY name, entity_id

list.name: min_contract_value
list.label: Min contract value (EUR)
list.description: Minimum absolute contract value in EUR. Contracts with abs(preco_contratual) below this are hidden from every panel. It is applied to the absolute value, so large negative values are kept. It works on top of the fixed EUR 10 rule used at ingest (contracts below EUR 10 are already excluded). Options: 0 (no extra filter), 10, 5000, 20000, 75000. The default is 10.

list.name: contract_type
list.label: Contract type
list.query: Ajuste direto : ajuste_direto,Concurso público : concurso_publico,Consulta prévia : consulta_previa,Other : other
list.description: Procedure family (procedure_family, from contracts.tipo_procedimento). Other = every procedure outside the three named families.

panels.title: Value distribution

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN abs(a.preco_contratual) < 1000 THEN '1) < 1k' WHEN abs(a.preco_contratual) < 5000 THEN '2) 1k-5k' WHEN abs(a.preco_contratual) < 20000 THEN '3) 5k-20k' WHEN abs(a.preco_contratual) < 75000 THEN '4) 20k-75k' WHEN abs(a.preco_contratual) < 250000 THEN '5) 75k-250k' ELSE '6) >= 250k' END AS band, count(DISTINCT a.idcontrato) AS contracts FROM procurement.v_adjudicatario_contracts a WHERE a.adjudicatario_id = '${adjudicatario}' AND (a.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND a.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND abs(a.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('${contract_type:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR a.procedure_family = ANY(string_to_array('${contract_type:csv}', ','))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Bands at the informal EUR 5 000 / 20 000 / 75 000 reference thresholds (the ones used in the notebooks), plus 1k and 250k.
